assessment: The official CPF has a Sfax regional office; its online services are title/application-based, and no map schema was verified. The city municipality hosts planning documents, not an anonymous parcel geometry service. WUP plausibility is low.
registryAssessment: Tunisia’s official Office of Land Ownership (CPF) lists a regional land-registration administration in Sfax. This confirms a local registration institution, but the source’s scope is regional and does not establish citywide parcel coverage. Its online title services require title/application identifiers or identity and were not used.
